prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1215; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, together with a certified copy of the declarations page and any other policies that may apply to this loss. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling it.

Your insured's duty to preserve evidence applies from the moment a claim is anticipated. We therefore ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, recorded statements, dashcam or telematics data, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, and any electronic communications. Please confirm in writing within fourteen days that this preservation request has been received and will be honored.
